headline: Public hearing on a residential tax exemption for FY 2027, plus $11,173,912.75 transfer to stabilization funds.
summary: A vote on a residential exemption and minimum residential factor for the FY 2027 tax rate comes after the public hearing. Other business includes changes to the shade tree and animal control rules, inclusionary zoning ordinances, and a grant for Linden Park Playground.
items: Mayoral reappointment of Leilani Ricardo to the Cultural Council, term to expire August 23, 2029
Mayoral appointment of Leonard Iovino as Fire Commissioner, term to expire March 1, 2027; recommended to be placed on file
Ordinance amending Code 11.16, Public Shade Trees; recommended to be referred to the Rules & Ordinance Committee
Malden Historical Commission FY2026 Annual Report; recommended to be placed on file
Public hearing and vote on a residential exemption and minimum residential factor for the FY 2027 tax rate, presented by Assessor Nathaniel Cramer
Appropriation of $11,173,912.75 from certified free cash to the General Purpose and Short Term Capital Needs stabilization funds
Vote on an easement to National Grid on behalf of Forest Dale Cemetery for five anchors and guys
Resolution supporting a grant application through the EEA PARC program for Linden Park Playground improvements
Enrolled ordinance 335-26 amending Code 12.12.300, Inclusionary Zoning
Enrolled ordinance 335A-26 adding section F, Incentives, to Code 12.12.300, Inclusionary Zoning
Enrolled ordinance 446-26 moving supervision of the Animal Control Officer in Title 2

Finance Committee report reducing the FY2027 Department of Public Works appropriation by $800,000, from $9,525,480 to $8,725,480, with the FY2026 snow and ice deficit to be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report
Tabled paper 285-26: National Grid and Verizon pole on Floral Avenue near Gordon Street, hearing required
location: City Council Chambers, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148

## 9. COMMITTEE REPORTS

**457-26** 

Committee Report: The Standing Committee on Finance to whom was referred Paper 448 Series of 2026, having considered the same make the following report:

**448-26** 

Ordered: That the FY2027 General Fund appropriation order, Schedule B, for the fiscal year July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, be and hereby is amended by reducing the appropriation for the Department of Public Works by Eight Hundred Thousand Dollars ($800,000), from Nine Million Five Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($9,525,480) to Eight Million Seven Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($8,725,480).

Said reduction shall eliminate the $800,000 appropriated within the Department of Public Works FY2027 budget for the FY2026 snow and ice deficit, which will instead be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report.

All other provisions of the FY2027 appropriation order shall remain unchanged.

Sponsors:

Carey McDonald
